## Problem

Describe the user or operating problem this change solves.

## Changes

Summarize the implementation and important tradeoffs.

## Validation

List the commands run and their observed results.

## Risk and Rollout

Describe migrations, permissions, external side effects, rollout steps, and rollback considerations. Write `None` when they do not apply.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] New behavior has appropriate automated coverage.
- [ ] Documentation and configuration examples match the implementation.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or generated test artifacts are committed.
